name: WA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Markets price a Democratic win at ~97%
Incumbency advantage with no serious opposition spending
model.rationale: DelBene holds a D+15 district, a large cash advantage, and no meaningful opposition funding or outside spending, while markets price her near-certain to win. The fundamentals support a Safe D rating with a margin in the low twenties.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing a tighter race would be the only signal worth monitoring.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzan DelBene seeks another term in a Seattle-area district that leans Democratic by about fifteen points. She has raised more than $3.5 million and holds over $1 million on hand, while Republican Mary Silva has raised only a few thousand dollars with no outside support on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give DelBene roughly a 97 percent chance of winning.

The combination of district lean, incumbency, and an overwhelming financial edge makes this a Safe Democratic race. A margin in the low twenties is expected, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
